The '''Culroon''' were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

==History==
The Culroon were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]]. A long history of violence and warfare amongst the population led to them never developing any form of space travel, although they were contacted by off-world [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] through which they acquired energy weapons. One of the Culroon, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Kloff]], used the influx of energy weapons to unite the people under his rule.<ref name="Promotion" />

During Kloff's rule, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Culroon III to subjugate the planet. The Imperial commanding officer, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]], arranged a ceremony between the Empire and the Culroon where they would exchange ceremonial weapons as a symbol of Culroon capitulation. Irrv's plan was questioned by one of his [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenants]], [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], who had studied the Culroon and knew that such a ceremony was unheard of in the planet's history and that a show of force would be more effective.<ref name="Promotion" />

During the ceremony, Kloff killed Irrv's aide, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]], and signalled an [[Insurrection on Culroon III|ambush]] on the Imperial force that was eventually routed by the arrival of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] commanded by Veers.<ref name="Promotion" />
